rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a state of intense surprise or wonder, especially in phrases such as 一臉驚訝.

example.english: I was filled with amazement when I saw him move all the furniture from the whole house by himself.
example.traditional: 見到佢一個人搬晒成間屋嘅傢俬，我真係一臉驚訝。
